task: Run the existing semantic-query regression against the Java compiler and close small missing query projections.
observation: The focused query regression found that Java did not route the advertised resolve command and returned not_applicable for a resolvable handler's statically constructed domain facts; the why command also omitted reason evidence. After bounded query-path changes, the full focused script passed.
impact: The regression provides inexpensive coverage for target resolution, handler/call-site facts, synchronization/domain projections, and structured why evidence. It does not establish full semantic-query parity because some projections remain heuristic and only this existing fixture set was exercised.

resolution.summary: Focused Phase 22.3 semantic-query regression and all ten Java unit-test classes pass on the working tree; broad query and compiler parity remain open.
